Packet Viewer (WebPC app)
  App UI (original WebPC code): scripts/pc/packets/*.mjs, esbuild-bundled into app.js + worker.js (production, minified).
  Dissection engine: @goodtools/wiregasm@2.0.0 (license: GPL-2.0-or-later)
    Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/@goodtools/wiregasm/-/wiregasm-2.0.0.tgz
    Integrity (npm dist.integrity): sha512-pAt6nckRGu8A1EDO0c0n6sXDtIZGLAWDdeeKiQDwtFxOP1RvKmyNE3okFKJkC9ex0/x2afuvYYMGWJCxepku/w==
    Upstream repo: https://github.com/good-tools/wiregasm (Wireshark 4.6 compiled to WebAssembly; source at the matching v2.0.0 tag / npm published tarball)
    Shipped here: wiregasm.wasm.gz + wiregasm.data.gz (raw 73 MB wasm and 2.6 MB data are NOT shipped;
    the page inflates the .gz files in the browser with DecompressionStream('gzip') and hands the bytes
    to the emscripten loader via wasmBinary + getPreloadedPackage, so the loader never fetches).
    Full licence text: LICENSE (this directory).
  Tweak: the worker sniffs the gzip magic (0x1f 0x8b) before inflating, because the local dev
    server answers .gz files with Content-Encoding: gzip and fetch then hands the worker already-
    inflated bytes; static hosts that serve the raw .gz are handled by the normal inflate path.
    No other tweaks — every loader-referenced asset (wiregasm.wasm, wiregasm.data) is covered by a
    shipped .gz file, and the loader makes zero runtime fetches. See docs/webpc/packets.md.
